brief_summary: After a screening, a 2-week, single-blind placebo run-in, 174 patients will be randomized in a 1 : 1 ratio to the addition of either once-daily Gemigliptin 50 mg or placebo to ongoing stable doses of glimepiride in combination with metformin for 24 weeks.
brief_title: Efficacy and Safety of Gemigliptin 50mg qd Added in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Inadequately Controlled on Glimepiride and Metformin

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
2. Adults aged ≥ 19 years old
3. Patients with HbA1c 7%\~11% at Visit 1

primary_outcomes.measure: Change of HbAlc from baseline at Week 24
